name: Semax & Selank Neurocognitive Protocol
title: Semax & Selank Neurocognitive Protocol
description: Clinical peptide protocol designed for cellular regeneration and systemic optimization.
clinicalRationale: Engineered according to clinical peptide consensus and pharmacokinetic half-life parameters.
clinical_rationale: Engineered according to clinical peptide consensus and pharmacokinetic half-life parameters.
evidenceGradeNote: Grade C: Strong preclinical evidence and multiple Russian State Pharmacopoeia Phase II/III clinical trials demonstrating nootropic and neuroprotective effects (Ashmarin IP et al., Neurosci Behav Physiol 2005; Semenova 2010). Graded C per Oxford CEBM/GRADE due to regional publication concentration and lack of multi-center Western RCTs.
evidence_grade_note: Grade C: Strong preclinical evidence and multiple Russian State Pharmacopoeia Phase II/III clinical trials demonstrating nootropic and neuroprotective effects (Ashmarin IP et al., Neurosci Behav Physiol 2005; Semenova 2010). contraindications: Active malignancy or uninvestigated neoplastic lesions
Severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class C) or end-stage renal disease
relativeCautions: History of cardiac arrhythmia or severe hypertension
Concurrent administration of insulin secretagogues without dose adjustment
expectedOutcomes: Restoration of target cellular and metabolic signaling pathways
Documented improvement in clinical biomarkers and subjective vigor
Sustained systemic resilience and tissue regeneration

compounds.name: Semax
compounds.storage: Refrigerate at 2°C – 8°C. Aqueous stability 30 days post-reconstitution.
compounds.clinicalNotes: Synthetic ACTH(4-10) analogue. Stimulates BDNF and TrkB signaling. Intranasal route delivers direct trans-cribriform CNS uptake.

compounds.name: Selank
compounds.timing: Morning and/or prior to acute cognitive or emotional stress
compounds.clinicalNotes: Tuftsin analogue modulating GABAergic transmission and dopamine/serotonin balance. Potent anxiolytic without sedation.
